body: I recognize it'd increase the scope of the PR, but from what I remember working with the animation editor, it could be confusing/difficult to zoom vertically when using Bezier curves. If that is the case, perhaps that could be used as a justification for this PR implementing the vertical bar, with a use case that verifies its functionality?

The PR should either implement it properly, or it should be removed.
The proposal does not mention Bezier editor, so it's out of scope IMO. Can be done in a follow-up.
Makes sense! That way, it's less work on the authors, and this PR can be more easily reviewed and approved.
